confidence_notes: Medium overall. Estimates are from general knowledge of Kathmandu tourist-district prices (Thamel, Lazimpat), projected to July 2026 (low monsoon season, which usually softens hotel rates) and converted at an assumed 142 NPR per USD (NPR is pegged to INR). Meal and beer anchors are most reliable; hostel and 1-star rates are less certain; the 3-star hotel is least certain given wide variation by location and season. Cocktail and wine are set at about 2.2x and 1.8x the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weak. Web search was used only for FX; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. FX 0.6955 (2026-10-15) came from search results citing the RBA statistics table, not a direct page read; those results also showed 0.7002 for 14 October, so verify the same-day 4pm figure before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: South Asian (Nepali) tourist-hub pricing, anchored on Kathmandu's Thamel and Lazimpat price levels from general knowledge. No live comparable-city lookups were performed.
